title.narrative: Support to Paralegal Advisory Services Institute (PASI)

description.narrative: This activity Support to Paralegal Advisory Services Institute (PASI) is a component of Justice for Vulnerable Groups in Malawi reported by FCDO with a funding type of 111 - Not for profit organisation and a budget of £2,334,262. It works in the following sector(s): Legal and judicial development, Human rights.
